summary: Refined the local dashboard with the public site's warm paper palette, light sidebar, dark utility bar, restrained lime/coral/blue accents, roomier typography and line-based overview sections. The avatar now opens a full main-content profile view rather than a side dialog; no profile navigation item or manual acknowledgement form is present. All 74 project tests passed, and the Edge browser flow passed for full-page profile navigation, source escaping, saved greeting preference, dark theme and mobile layout. Desktop and mobile screenshots were inspected. Changes remain uncommitted.
